messages:
Leo: Heads-up 1: MeridianOne POC starts tomorrow 08:00 PT. They asked for a single one-pager: reserved GPU split, autoscale behavior for 2-6min spikes, KV preheat expectations, and a note on quantized runtime licensing.
Camila: Traffic sketch?
Leo: From their SRE: steady 180 qps embeddings, 60 qps generation. Typical daily spike to ~1.1k qps lasting 3-6 minutes, target 95p embedding latency 130ms. Business-hours SLA Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00 PT.
Hector: Ballpark reserved sizing: steady + 20% -> reserve for ~260 qps. That maps to 3 x A100-eq for latency headroom. Recommend autoscale max 6 for spikes with burst credits.
Ava: They asked if we can AZ-spread. Yes, recommend 2+1 (primary + failover) if budget tight; 2+2 preferred for symmetric failover. Document degraded tail if failover occurs.
Leo: What about preheat/runbook so they can sign security questionnaire?
Hector: Use our standard: schedule preheat 30m before expected peak, KV replay at 30% peak for 5m, short synthetic QPS soak at 50% for 5m, validate KV hit-rate >85%. If not ready, fallback to burst credits.
Camila: Autoscale snippet for their ops team (copyable):
```json
{ "autoscale": { "min_reserved_gpus": "3", "max_gpus": "6", "scale_step": "1", "cooldown_s": "180", "preheat_window_mins": "30", "burst_credits": "enabled", "burst_qps_cap": "1500" }}
```
Ava: Recommend cooldown 180s to avoid oscillation with short spikes. Also set per-customer burst cap so one tenant can't exhaust pool.
Camila: Licensing: quantized runtime included in infra fee; legal wants a simple line in contract. I'll propose: "Redwood's quantized inference runtime is provided under the platform fee; no additional runtime license required."
Leo: Pricing ask: they want blended reserved + burst quote. Presales rule: reserved = monthly commit rate, burst credits sold in blocks of hours at incremental rate, 5% surcharge for cross-AZ reserved.
Hector: Observability checklist to include in questionnaire: per-route token counts, 95/99/99.9 latency percentiles, KV hit-rate, preheat job logs, audit trail for preheat triggers. All surfaced in Console + API.
ops-bot: Maintenance notice: planned infra maintenance tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. Schedule preheat outside this window. :warning:
Leo: We'll move preheat earlier.
Ava: I'll draft the one-pager: sizing rationale, autoscale snippet, preheat runbook, pricing bullets, and the licensing line.
Camila: I'll add the formal legal wording and pricing numbers after Ava's draft.
Hector: I'll attach a tiny KV warmup script and k6 load snippet for their SREs.
Leo: Action list: (1) Ava draft one-pager (2) Camila add legal + pricing (3) Hector attach scripts. Aim to send in 2 hours. Thanks all. :rocket:
